name: GDrive Backup
description: Save & load your data to Google Drive!

slot-count.name: Save slots count
slot-count.description: Choose how many save slots are available. Note that this setting is purely <cg>visual</c>, changing this value does <cy>not</c> delete your save files.

button-position.name: Button position
button-position.description: Sets the position of the mod's button on the <cg>account menu</c>.

bottom-button.name: Main menu shortcut button
bottom-button.description: Adds a button for GDrive Backup to the bottom of the main menu <cc>(next to the geode button)</c>.

new-icon.name: Use new Drive icon
new-icon.description: Use the new weird gradient-y google drive icon for the buttons instead of the 'lame' 'old' 'one'

advanced-title.name: Backup Settings
advanced-title.description: Manage which data is included in saves, and what to load from saves! <cy>these options are local to this device, and aren't synced between devices.</c>

platformer-data.name: Platformer saves
platformer-data.description: Includes all your saved platformer checkpoints.

level-back-data.name: editor auto-backups
level-back-data.description: Includes all your auto-backups of editor levels.

keybind-data.name: Custom keybinds
keybind-data.description: Includes your current set custom keybinds.

game-options.name: Game & editor options
game-options.description: Load game & editor options (such as quick keys, CBS, button rows, link controls, etc.). <cc>Note that this doesn't load every single option, and mainly excludes graphics options</c>.
